title: Yes and No
label: ch:it-si-e-no
canDo: I can say yes and no, take or turn down what is offered, agree, and ask somebody to confirm what I have just said.

payoff.summary: The chapter's last lesson gives vero its second job — the tag hung on the end of a statement to ask the other person to confirm it — and gathers the four answering moves the chapter opened: sì, no, sì grazie / no grazie, and d'accordo.
